required_gate_template_for_any_financial.identification_before_estimation: one predeclared treatment with a clean counterfactual; no metadata rule that encodes semantics; no weak first-versus-repeat instrument
required_gate_template_for_any_financial.fixed_primary_plus_horizon_5_is_advisory: the fixed primary-plus-horizon-5 choice is an advisory legacy convention, not a law; a new study needs its own prospective economic justification for its horizon
required_gate_template_for_any_financial.stock_row: same-source synthetic benchmark reference, not a sixth trade
required_gate_template_for_any_financial.option_exit_marks_before_expiry: mark-to-market; expiration intrinsic valid only at the exp horizon
required_gate_template_for_any_financial.company_cluster_cis: fixed seed, 1000 draws, minimum finite-draw fraction, one primary comparison, declared multiplicity treatment
required_gate_template_for_any_financial.costs: commission, funding, premium-haircut scenarios plus modeled break-even haircut; no executable-spread claim
required_gate_template_for_any_financial.year_and_horizon_sensitivity: 2024 and 2025 separately, all fixed horizons, full frozen OTM/bucket/entry-delay/stale grid
required_gate_template_for_any_financial.no_lookahead_and_timing: first eligible session after publication; acceptance pre-open vs post-close handled; filing lag named; pre-news jump never used
required_gate_template_for_any_financial.no_floor_relaxation: 60 matched / 20 issuer is an internal Experiment 6 gate, not an organizer rule; replace only via a new pre-outcome power-justified floor

candidate_b_source_completeness.binding_gap_all_filings_history: a 20-session quiet interval needs the issuer's complete filing history; tag-selected caches miss filings under other tags and cannot prove an interval was quiet
candidate_b_source_completeness.event_co_occurrence: one accession can carry several item tags and issuers; must state accessions vs filings vs issuer-days and avoid double counting
candidate_b_source_completeness.warmup_not_truncation: January 2022 is not a left-truncation bias for the 2024-2025 financial window when an adequate allowed pre-2024 warmup is used
candidate_b_source_completeness.timing_lag: filing_date has no time of day and the 8-K is due within four business days; the 20-session window is a filing-date window
candidate_b_source_completeness.deterministic_selection: split and interval length must be frozen with fixed tie-breaking; no post-outcome length choice
candidate_b_source_completeness.sample_and_multiple_testing: threshold, split and controls form a family; one primary comparison and declared multiplicity treatment required
candidate_b_source_completeness.classifier_drift: first vs repeat is metadata; it becomes a classifier if it adds filing type, materiality or same-topic judgments
candidate_b_source_completeness.conclusion: B is rejected for weak identification and an incomplete current source base, not for unauthorized acquisition
